findings.title: Reentrancy in SampleVault.withdraw(uint256)
findings.description: SampleVault.withdraw(uint256) (contracts/SampleVault.sol#50-60) sends eth to arbitrary user. Dangerous calls: token.safeTransfer(msg.sender,amount) (contracts/SampleVault.sol#56)

findings.title: SampleVault.constructor(address,uint256,address)._token lacks a zero-check
findings.description: SampleVault.constructor(address,uint256,address)._token (contracts/SampleVault.sol#30) lacks a zero-check on: token = IERC20(_token)

findings.title: SampleVault.setFeeRate(uint256) allows owner to change fee rate
findings.description: SampleVault.setFeeRate(uint256) (contracts/SampleVault.sol#62-65) allows the owner to change the fee rate up to 10%, which could be used to extract value from depositors.
